name: Octobyte IRIS QR Payments for WooCommerce
author: octobyte

sections.description:
Start accepting IRIS QR payments through WooCommerce in minutes.

Upload your business QR code once and give customers a clear way to pay from their banking app. The plugin adds IRIS as a familiar WooCommerce payment option, shows the right instructions throughout the order journey, and keeps the order waiting for your confirmation.

No API credentials or complicated payment-provider integration are required.

A simple payment journey

  1. The customer chooses IRIS at checkout.
  2. WooCommerce places the order and shows your business QR code.
  3. The customer scans the QR, enters the order total and completes the transfer in their banking app.
  4. You confirm the payment in your bank account and continue processing the order.

Everything customers need to complete payment

  • Add a dedicated IRIS QR payment option to WooCommerce.
  • Upload or select your QR code directly from the WordPress Media Library.
  • Write clear payment instructions for your own store and customers.
  • Show the QR code and order reference on the thank-you page.
  • Include the same payment details in supported customer emails.
  • Keep instructions available in My Account while the order is unpaid.
  • Display the optional IRIS logo beside the payment method.

Fits your WooCommerce workflow

  • Works with both Classic Checkout and WooCommerce Cart and Checkout Blocks.
  • Choose whether new IRIS orders are placed on hold or marked pending payment.
  • Choose whether stock is reduced when the order is placed.
  • Temporarily make IRIS unavailable while keeping it visible to customers.
  • Add a custom message explaining when the method will be available again.
  • Choose inline QR, linked QR or link-only behavior for customer emails.
  • Keep or remove saved plugin settings when uninstalling.

Independent and lightweight

Octobyte IRIS QR Payments presents the QR image and instructions configured by the store owner. The payment itself happens securely inside the customer’s banking app, while the store owner confirms receipt from their bank account.

Octobyte is not affiliated with or endorsed by IRIS, DIAS, any bank or payment provider.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments.
  3. Select IRIS (QR) – Offline.
  4. Upload your business IRIS QR code.
  5. Review the checkout description and customer instructions.
  6. Enable the payment method and save your changes.

Customers can now choose IRIS at checkout. Their order will wait in your selected unpaid status until you confirm the transfer.
sections.faq:
Does the customer make a real IRIS payment?

Yes. The customer scans your business QR code and completes the transfer inside their own banking app.

Is the order total entered automatically?

That depends on the QR supplied by your bank. With a static business QR, the customer normally enters the amount manually. Your instructions should tell them to enter the WooCommerce order total.

Does the plugin automatically confirm the payment?

No. Check your bank account to confirm that the transfer arrived, then continue processing the WooCommerce order. No bank API credentials are required by the plugin.

What happens to the order after checkout?

You can place new IRIS orders on hold or mark them pending payment. The selected status remains in place until you review the payment and update the order.

Where does the QR code appear?

It can appear on the thank-you page, in supported customer emails and in the customer’s My Account order view while the order is unpaid.

Does it work with the WooCommerce Checkout Block?

Yes. The plugin supports both block-based and classic WooCommerce checkout experiences.

Can I temporarily pause IRIS payments?

Yes. The unavailable state keeps the method visible but prevents selection. You can show a custom message so customers know why it is temporarily unavailable.

Is this an official IRIS or bank plugin?

No. This is independent software by Octobyte. It does not connect to, represent or receive endorsement from IRIS, DIAS, a bank or a payment provider.

Does installing the plugin guarantee regulatory compliance?

The plugin provides a manual QR payment workflow for WooCommerce. Payment, banking, accounting and regulatory requirements can vary, so store owners should confirm the appropriate setup with their bank and professional advisers.

What happens to my settings if I uninstall it?

Settings are preserved by default. You can enable the data-removal option if you want saved plugin settings deleted during uninstall.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Introduced the Octobyte IRIS QR Payments product identity.
  • Rebuilt the WordPress.org description, installation guide and FAQ around the complete customer payment journey.
  • Added Greek IRIS search metadata and detailed screenshot captions.
  • Added a custom WordPress.org icon, product banner and five feature screenshots.
  • Kept the existing payment functionality unchanged.

1.0.0

  • Added an offline IRIS QR payment method for WooCommerce.
  • Added Classic Checkout and Cart and Checkout Blocks support.
  • Added QR instructions to the thank-you page, customer emails and My Account order view.
  • Added configurable unpaid order status, stock reduction and email display behavior.
  • Added a temporary unavailable state with an optional customer message.
